issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring tests for every feature and failure/authorization paths.
Date-from-issued_at parsing with try/catch fallback is duplicated in Ticket creating hook and TicketFactory afterMaking instead of sharing a helper.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:38-54, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:76 Gate authorize + :74 priorityPrefixMap param, app/Models/Queue.php:118 Fillable excludes map + :142 saving hook + down() migrations, docs/business-rules.md docs/database-schema.md CHANGELOG.md synced; violates TDD: change.diff:1-660 contains no tests/* files

review.summary: Implements per-priority letter daily ticket sequences with custom map validation, scoped nextCode, single-clock issuance, factory day alignment and docs. Correct on requirements, conventions (except tests), security and scope, but ships no tests despite mandatory TDD, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
